name: jlib
description: SyWare's component library for coding agents: jlib-official, to build apps with jlib's components, and syware-ux, to make them behave like SyWare's apps.

plugins.name: jlib-official
plugins.description: The official jlib skill: every component and its whole API, an app's frame and pages, lists, forms, states and feedback, theming, texts, tests, server rendering, the mistakes agents make with jlib, and a self-check. Installs jadis-official with it.

plugins.name: syware-ux
plugins.description: How SyWare apps behave, from jlib's UX patterns: the frame, pages, lists, actions and their words, forms, states, feedback, confirmations, statuses, phones, every pattern page in full, and the checklist a page is reviewed against. Installs jlib-official with it.
